name: GPS Consistency Analysis
description: Validates GPS coordinate presence, format consistency, and plausibility. AI-generated images rarely contain valid GPS coordinates, making this a strong authenticity indicator.
algorithm: GPS Coordinate Validator with DMS Parser
mechanism: Extracts GPS-related metadata fields, validates coordinate ranges, detects placeholder values (0,0), checks for exact integer coordinates, and parses both decimal and DMS (Degrees/Minutes/Seconds) formats.
parameters:
GPS fields analyzed: GPSLatitude, GPSLongitude, GPSAltitude, GPSTimeStamp
Valid ranges: Latitude [-90, 90], Longitude [-180, 180]
accuracy: High - 85%+ when GPS data is present. Strong positive indicator for real photos.
source: EXIF 2.32 GPS IFD, WGS 84 Geodetic Reference System
